info.title: Mission Control API
info.description:
Job-search command center API.

**Trying it here:** click **Authorize** and enter `mission-control` for `csrfHeader` (needed on every POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE). Then call `POST /auth/login`: the browser stores the session cookie and sends it on the following calls.

get.summary: Liveness: is the process running?
Readiness: can this instance serve traffic?
get.description: Pings MongoDB (1 s timeout). Returns 503 while the database is down or the server is shutting down.

post.description: Always returns **202** with the same body, whether or not the email is already registered, so the response can't be used to discover accounts. New accounts get a verification email; existing owners get a notice. Does **not** log in: call `/auth/login` next.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many attempts; see the `Retry-After` header.

post.description: Creates a session and sets the `mc_session` cookie. Wrong email and wrong password give the same error. Limited to 5 failed attempts per IP + email and 20 per IP per 15 minutes.

Set-Cookie.description: `mc_session` cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production, 30 days.

post.summary: Store emails sent by the Gmail capture script
post.description: Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <capture token>` (no cookie, no CSRF header). Up to 20 emails per call, 2 MB body. Emails already stored (same `gmailId`) are ignored, so the script can safely resend. 120 calls per hour per token.

data.description: Type-specific details, e.g. `{ from, to }` for status_changed or `{ body }` for note. Includes `applicationTitle` and `companyName` snapshots.
